NOTE
**Still not ready**

|     |         |
| --- | ------- |
| ⚠️ | Discuss in an issue first: #37647 exists and the author mentions it in the comment, but the PR description doesn't link it |
| ❌ | PR template: no "Fixes: #N", no testing notes, no before/after screenshots for this UI change, no self-review checklist |
| ℹ️ | The only new push is a rebase (same +24/-4, same commit), and CI is passing |
| ℹ️ | The description says the fix came from "code analysis", with no sign it was checked in a browser |
| ℹ️ | Open PR #39267 targets the same issue, and two earlier attempts (#38352, #38370) were closed. The input doesn't show whether #37647 has "help wanted", so check it before handing this off |

###### Next step

Keep "not ready" and ask for the template fields. If #37647 turns out to lack "help wanted" or #39267 is further along, close it instead.

###### Reply

```quote
Thanks for the rebase, @Shinu-Cherian! Please add "Fixes: #37647" to the PR description and include before/after screenshots plus how you tested it in the browser (see the [review process guide](https://zulip.readthedocs.io/en/latest/contributing/review-process.html)). Please also confirm how this differs from #39267, which targets the same issue.
```
